# SD18 deterministic Human Bard level 14 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1..level-13 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_bard_level13_widening.rs) to level 14 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/performance posture from the level-1 through level-13
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The PF1
# Core Rulebook Bard class table's level-14 "Special" column reads
# "Frightening tune, Versatile performance" (verified independently
# against d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, both
# byte-for-byte identical), so no new choice line is required: Frightening
# Tune is grounded only as a flat Will-save DC magnitude (no choice slot),
# and the repeat Versatile Performance grant stays named-but-unproven
# exactly as at levels 2/6/10, requiring no new choice line either.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no
# performance-state engine (start/maintain action economy, round
# tracking/consumption), no Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile
# Performance execution, no Suggestion execution, no Dirge of Doom execution,
# no Inspire Greatness execution, no untrained-skill-use execution for
# Jack-of-All-Trades, no Lore Master take-10/take-20 execution against any
# actual Knowledge check, no Soothing Performance healing/condition-removal
# execution, no Frightening Tune fear-resolution execution, and no
# spontaneous known-spell / slot posture burden. Base attack bonus and
# both good saves (Reflex, Will) genuinely rise from level 13
# (14*3/4=10, 14/2+2=9), poor Fortitude stays unchanged (14/3=4, an
# integer-division coincidence with level 13), Bardic Knowledge and the
# Bardic Performance rounds-per-day pool both genuinely rise, and the
# Fascinate DC genuinely rises while the Fascinate affected-creature count
# stays unchanged (14/2=7, up from 13/2=6; (14-1)/3=4 == (13-1)/3=4, an
# integer-division coincidence).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level14
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:14
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
